_note: Relative chronology of Velari sound laws. Dates are relative ticks on a draft internal timeline, not canon calendar years. A compound formed at date T evolves as separate words under every law dated before T, then as one word under every law dated T or later.

elder.description: Old Velari coinages: the great houses and the people-names.

middle.description: Coined after junction syncope but before apocope; the linking vowel survives (Vela-, Varna-).

scribal.description: Coined after the Thessari scribal reform; elements were already worn-down words, and scribes mark the junction with an apostrophe.

scribal_reform.description: Thessari scribes begin marking compound junctions. Junctions formed on or after this date are written with an apostrophe.

laws.name: w-fortition
laws.description: *w hardens to v at the start of an element.

laws.name: t-aspiration
laws.description: *t becomes th at the start of an element before e.

laws.name: u-fronting
laws.description: *u fronts to y under primary stress.

laws.name: junction syncope
laws.description: Unstressed stem-final *a is lost before an internal boundary.

laws.name: apocope
laws.description: Unstressed word-final *a is lost after a consonant in words of two or more syllables.

laws.name: high-vowel gemination
laws.description: An element-final n after a high vowel doubles, compensating for the lost vowel.

laws.name: i-rounding
laws.description: i rounds to y before a geminate nn.

laws.name: proclitic elision
laws.description: The vowel of a proclitic is lost before the word it leans on.
